summary: Avoid worktree lease processes for unchanged render output

schema.detail: No SQLite schema, index or client schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Render passes still plan all members and union shared Git excludes. Only members needing output or legacy cleanup acquire deletion admission; unchanged plans publish receipts without committing. Mutating members revalidate their workspace and reprepare output under the lease; a changed plan is deferred rather than applied with stale graph decisions. Normalized worktree identities survive through start admission and are stored in existing local start-operation JSON bodies, including bare repositories nested inside parent worktrees. New-format recovery validates persisted workspace identity. Older records without admission acquire it lazily at dispatch under the original operation and request; quiet and handoff boundaries remain unchanged. Unavailable legacy admission leaves the operation queued with a stable deduplicated diagnostic for retry. Completion reacquires admission through the same legacy fallback without rewriting stored bodies. Later lifecycle controls still fence dispatch. Missing/replaced new-format workspaces permit durable producer retirement. Declared checkouts are revalidated at every start boundary, including retained leases. No start recreates a checkout as a plain directory. Legacy-cleanup inspection failures fail closed.

recovery.detail: No data migration; binary rollback remains available.
